== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of Obsidian Squadron TIE with the bronze errata disc, from the starwarsccg.org card lists; this file is the earliest archived copy, uploaded unchanged: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818004044/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/OfficialTournamentSealedDeck-Dark/large/obsidiansquadrontie.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Obsidian Squadron TIE (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]].
